The IWC Portugieser Chronograph with steel bracelet — reference IW371617 is the steel bracelet version... Let me think. IWC Portugieser Chronograph references: IW371604 (steel, silver-plated dial, black leather strap), IW371605 (steel, blue dial... actually IW371605 is blue dial on strap), IW371606 (steel, silver dial...). The new-generation Portugieser Chronograph (2020) references: IW371604 (silver dial / black strap?), IW371605 (blue), IW371606 (silver dial with gold indices?), IW371609 (black...). And bracelet versions: IW371617 is silver-plated dial on steel bracelet. Yes, IW371617 = Portugieser Chronograph steel bracelet, silver-plated dial. Hmm, I need to check. Actually I recall IW371617 being the stainless steel bracelet version with silver-plated dial (the one in the photo shows silver dial with blue hands, which is the "silver-plated dial, blue hands" version). IW371617 matches: "Portugieser Chronograph, stainless steel, silver-plated dial, stainless steel bracelet." I'll go with IW371617 with moderate confidence ~0.5.

Movement: automatic (IWC calibre 69355). Case material: stainless-steel. Bracelet: metal.

Confidence maybe 0.45-0.55.
